source: READ-ONLY select on lnhulykjlxmoneappnsp, 2026-11-13: dashboards (owner_scope=vicdata, kind=dashboard) joined to their published dashboard_versions row. Refreshed from the 2026-10-17 snapshot: admissions.market-share v1->v2, admissions.pipelines v2->v3, smt.academic v1->v2 and smt.pupils v1->v2 (republished 8 Nov; each config's md5 matches live's v.config::text); the other six are at the same published versions as on 17 Oct.
query: select d.slug, d.name, d.kind, v.version, v.schema_version, v.config from dashboards d join dashboard_versions v on v.id = d.published_version_id where d.owner_scope = 'vicdata' and d.kind = 'dashboard' order by d.slug
